<action type="say">
Flight status for UA9020 on 2027-06-15 isn’t available yet. Airlines and tracking systems usually only publish detailed status (and often even the exact schedule) for flights within roughly 10–11 months (about 330 days) of departure.

This doesn’t mean the flight won’t operate; it just hasn’t entered the status window. To check it later, you can:

- Look it up on United’s website or app under “Flight status” once you’re within about 10 months of the date, using “UA9020” and the date.
- Ask me again closer to the time (within that 10–11 month window) and I can pull real-time status, gates, and any delays.
